note: Private campground beside its own airstrip (4WV4; fly-in guests by permission) near the South Branch Potomac River. Catch-and-release fishing pond, no swimming. --Claude
summary: Operator site, policy PDFs and ResNexus: $40 W/E to $49 full hookup confirmed (ResNexus $49 dated today), 50-amp full hookups, 50 RV sites with pull-throughs, Wi-Fi, laundry; season May 1-Oct 31 (monthly winter campers Nov-Apr); reservable online. Note: the airstrip guess replaced by the stated private airstrip.
flags: Missing phone: the operator gives (304) 703-5898 and (304) 703-5878.

Long-stay check: the park takes monthly renters ('Monthly rentals: It is your responsibility to keep up with payments'; winter campers $600/month, 2-month commitment, November-April), and on ResNexus for 2026-10-21 only 3 of the 34 full-hookup sites were bookable (the rest OCCUPIED; the W/E sites not shown). Nights are for sale at a posted $40-49 with an online booking engine, so it looks like it passes, but a human may want to judge how much of the park is monthly.
